sentences.text:
IS MADE AS UNDER:
 ORAL ORDER Smt.Vidyavati M.Kotturshettar., learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri.Shivaprabhu S.Hiremath.,
learned AGA for respondents 1 to 3, 5 and 6 and Sri.Chetan Munnoli., learned counsel for respondent No.4 have appeared in person.
2.

The captioned Writ Petition is filed seeking a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to publish final notification under Section 19 of the Act, 2013 taking note of the representations submitted by the petitioners.
3. Learned counsel for the respective parties urged several contentions.
Heard, the contention urged on behalf of respective parties and perused the Writ papers with utmost care.

4. The petitioners are aggrieved by a common cause of action as their lands were acquired for the Upper Krishna NC: 2024:KHC-D:11480 project due to the submergence of the lands into the backwaters of Almatti dam and the rise in its height.

5. The fifth respondent issued a preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act (hereinafter referred to as 'Act of 2013' for brevity) for acquisition on 19.08.2022.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Despite the process of issuance of notification under Section 11(1) of the Act of 2013, the final notification has not been passed by the respondent - authorities.
Hence, the petitioners are before this Court seeking a Writ of Mandamus for a direction to the respondents to issue final notification as the lands have been utilized by the beneficiary.

6. Because of the submergence of the petitioners' lands and the preliminary notification issuance,
nothing further remains except for the statutory authorities/ State to issue final notification for acquisition, following the law.
Thereafter disburse the compensation in favor of the petitioners without much delay.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is allowed.

A Writ of Mandamus is issued to respondents 3, 5 and 6 to pass a suitable order of acquisition of the lands belonging to the petitioners as stated in this petition under Section 19, by considering the representations submitted by the petitioners, following the law, within an outer limit of four weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Sd/-
